notes: Zone is the Twin Falls city limits only, from the City of Twin Falls' own City Limits layer (tfportal.tfid.org, feature last edited 2026-04-06, retrieved 2026-11-13; ArcGIS item c23dba474b6c418c8ad73c8ef4fd4620). It keeps the layer's county islands as holes. The layer's outline pinches onto itself where one county island (around 42.540, -114.462) touches it, so that island is drawn as its own hole and the 94 m2 sliver joining it to the outline is left in the zone (the map gate rejects outlines that touch themselves). Cross-checked against the Census TIGERweb place boundary (GEOID 1682810): same outline, 53.2 vs 51.4 km2. The City (Mandi Thompson, email reply to the Nov 12 request) says the service area is the city limits plus Magic Valley Regional Airport and Shoshone Falls Park. The City Limits layer already takes in Shoshone Falls Park and Dierkes Lake (OpenStreetMap's park and lake outlines fall wholly inside it), so they are drawn. The airport is outside the city limits and not drawn yet: no public boundary was found (to be requested from the City, CIV-1455). Ride TFT also runs after-hours rides at a higher fare, but its pages give no after-hours times, so only the regular hours are used. No pickup method is stated, so none is given.
